options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of your NetOrca team. The NetOrca API supports API-key authentication only - there is no username/password mode. Treat the key like a password - supply it via the E(NETORCA_API_KEY) environment variable (for example from a CI/CD secret) or from Ansible Vault, never as a literal in a playbook. If not set, the value of the E(NETORCA_API_KEY) environment variable is used.

options.name: api_url
options.description: Base URL of the NetOrca API, for example C(https://api.example.netorca.io). The URL is normalised to end in a single C(/v1), so passing it with or without the suffix both work. If not set, the value of the E(NETORCA_API_URL) environment variable is used.

options.name: chunk_overlap
options.description: Characters of overlap between consecutive document chunks.

options.name: context
options.description: Point of view for the request. The same query returns different data depending on which side of the service relationship your team is on. V(serviceowner) operates on the services your team I(offers) - the requests made against them, their service items and deployed items. This is the side that validates, approves, deploys and completes changes. options.name: cosine_similarity_threshold
options.description: Minimum cosine similarity a chunk needs to be considered a match.

options.name: embedding_model
options.description: Name of the embedding model used to index and query documents.

options.name: pack_enabled
options.description: The master switch - whether the Pack framework runs for this service at all.

options.name: query_config
options.description: Vector-query shaping - C(exclude_fields) and C(exact_search) lists. Compared as a whole when supplied.

options.name: return_all_documents
options.description: Retrieve every document in full instead of the O(top_k) best chunks.

options.name: service_id
options.description: ID of the service the profile belongs to.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the profile should exist. Deleting a profile reverts the service to the platform defaults.

options.name: top_k
options.description: How many of the best-matching chunks are retrieved into a prompt.

options.name: universal_executor_enabled
options.description: Whether the platform-side universal executor handles this service's execution stage.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate TLS certificates when talking to the API. Only disable this for lab instances with self-signed certificates. If not set, the value of the E(NETORCA_VALIDATE_CERTS) environment variable is used.
